title: Auto Train And Auto Win Auto Destroy Waves KEYLESS
script:
local enabled = true

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function getTargetButton()
    for _, winsFolder in ipairs(workspace.JungleMap.Map.Stages.WinButton:GetChildren()) do
        if winsFolder.Name == "Wins" then
            local winCollect = winsFolder:FindFirstChild("WinCollect")
            if winCollect then
                local frame = winCollect:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                if frame then
                    local textLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                    if textLabel and textLabel.Text:find("+65,000 Wins") then
                        local button = winsFolder:FindFirstChild("Button")
                        if button and button:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") then
                            return button
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait() and enabled do
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(23, 7, -51)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.1) and enabled do
        for _, v in ipairs(workspace.Waves:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Model") then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end)

while task.wait(0.5) and enabled do
    local button = getTargetButton()
    if button then
        firetouchinterest(hrp, button, 0)
        task.wait(0.1)
        firetouchinterest(hrp, button, 1)
    end
end
